ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black/dark grey) pixels constituting approximately 85-90% of the visible surface, with high-intensity (white) pixels concentrated at the distal tips and in scattered focal points.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Concentrated high-intensity mottling on the terminal tips of both lobes. Sparse, circular white pixel clusters (0.5-2% total area) distributed across the central and proximal regions of the lobes. High-intensity linear border along portions of the leading edge.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a calculated interior angle of approximately 65 degrees at the vertex.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous boundary characterized by low-frequency, low-amplitude serrations. Notable singular peak adjacent to the left side of the median notch and minor irregular jaggedness along the medial trailing edges.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward-sweeping concave curves extending from the median notch to the lateral distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple distinct high-contrast white circular clusters (1-5 pixel diameter) scattered across the lower-left and lower-central regions of the fluke.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Set of 3-4 unaligned, diagonal white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) localized on the upper-right lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive white pigmentation/scarring covering the distal 5-10% of both fluke tips, showing irregular pixel boundaries against the black base.
